# Dealer Agent Protocol

Dealer Agent Protocol is an open, MCP-native retail inventory and offer profile for AI agents. Version 0.1 covers dealer and rooftop identity, published vehicle inventory, authoritative availability, advertised prices, required dealer charges, discounts, rebates, incentives, provenance, freshness, and uncertainty.

It is not a DMS API, CRM API, lead protocol, or dealership-system integration standard. Version 0.1 does not include customer records, appointments, holds, desking, credit, payments, contracts, service, parts, or marketing.

## Reference endpoint

- Streamable HTTP: https://mcp.dealeragentgateway.com/mcp
- Data status: synthetic reference data only
